newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait Airways closes Boeing finance tender.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait Airways closes Boeing finance tender.

text.p: The national flag carrier Kuwait Airways Corp on Sunday closes a tender to finance the purchase of two Boeing Co 777-200, officials said.
The carrier is seeking a $280 million financing deal for the two aircraft which were ordered in June for delivery in 1998. It has an option on a third 777 twinjet.
"The offers will be reviewed by the financial committee on Wednesday," a Kuwait Airways official said.

He said several international and regional banks and finance houses had presented offers including CitiBank, Japan's Sumitomo Bank, the Bahrain-based Gulf International Bank (GIB), a consortium of Kuwaiti banks under National Bank of Kuwait and other institutions.
The two new 777s will replace two Boeing 747s currently in service. Kuwait Airways also has 15 Airbus Industrie aircraft and flies to some 50 destinations.
